reminders.text:
Telegram bot plan — the two-week observation period (docs/telegram-bot.md §7 step 3) ends today.

To implement next, in order:
1. v2 /merge (§4) — prerequisites: pr-checks.yml ✓ exists; bind Confirm to the PR head SHA; refuse unless a completed, successful check exists on that SHA; require an approving review on autofix PRs. Autofix PRs must then be opened with a fine-grained PAT (Contents + Pull requests: write, LionTime only) so pr-checks runs on them.
2. v2 overrides, closures only (§5): registry → adapters, Library first → freshness contract → commands.
3. v3 natural language (§6).

Also check: autofix cost lines over the past two weeks stayed under $0.50/run (levers: DAILY_CEILING, --max-turns); and the old NewsAgent bot token still needs revoking in @BotFather.
